name: drift-check
description: When a reply does not start with your opening text (an emoji, a word or a name), asks Claude to check that reply against CLAUDE.md and fix what slipped.

marker.title: Opening text
marker.description: What every reply must start with: an emoji, a word or a name (e.g. 🌊). Your CLAUDE.md needs the rule "Start every message with <it>". Empty: the check stays idle. Without it, CLAUDE_REPLY_MARKER in settings.json env is used.
